subject_scope: same frozen 12 corrected C1-primary Knight d8 roots as X1
motivation: X1 showed direct contour-vertex residual improves approximately 4x per depth halving for most roots, but one root retained a large residual tail at d11/d12. The field is piecewise due triplane bilinear interpolation. X1B tests whether forcing contour blocks to end at exact align_corners=False triplane texel boundaries removes cross-regime interpolation error without globally increasing depth.
knot_definition: for W=48, internal normalized-coordinate boundaries are -1 + 2*k/W, k=1..W-1
arms: UNIFORM_ROOT_MC at effective d11 and d12
KNOT_ALIGNED_BLOCK_MC with each root split at every internal triplane knot crossing X/Y/Z and per-interval cell count ceil(interval_width / uniform_target_h)
merge_contract: block MC vertices are globally welded by rounded world position only for this research diagnostic; seam audit reports duplicate, degenerate and nonmanifold topology
frozen_metrics: direct float64 field residual at emitted vertices
symmetric point-cloud distance versus the corresponding uniform arm
primary_comparison: per-root d11 and d12 p95 gradient-normalized residual ratio KNOT_ALIGNED / UNIFORM

interpretation.KNOT_ALIGNMENT_CAUSAL: knot-aligned blocks materially reduce residual on one or more knot-crossing roots without introducing seam/topology alarms, while non-knot roots remain unchanged by construction
interpretation.NO_MATERIAL_KNOT_EFFECT: residual changes are small relative to the depth effect
interpretation.KNOT_ALIGNMENT_TOPOLOGY_RISK: seam/nonmanifold/duplicate alarms appear despite residual improvement

claim_boundary: X1B is a local causal diagnostic only. It cannot promote block MC or replace full VF11/Stage13 replay.
